.]]__NOTOC__ Gift of Agthia is located on a rock near the Temple of Courage in Bastion. Interacting with Agthia's Flame at the Temple of Courage will give a temporary torch buff which must be brought to another torch a little south. Lighting this will create an invisible bridge that must be walked across. Continue to light the flames and follow the paths until the Gift is reached.

Gift of Devos is located at the Temple of Devotion in Bastion. The Flame of Devotion must be looted, brought and deposited in the Brazier of Devotion next to the Gift. allows the Gift to be looted. While this seems easy, healing, taking damage and mounting remove the torch buff, so planning out the journey and killing mobs around the Gift beforehand is a must. It can also be easier to acquire whenever Disloyal Denizens is active, with the AOE blasts from the defense structures near stairs to be the main obstacle.

Gift of Vesiphone is located at Purity's Pinnacle in Bastion. To begin, the player must click either Bell of Purification to the sides of the Gift and rid themselves of the Lingering Impurity. While the debuff is active, stand under the waterfall to receive , allowing the Gift to be looted. It can also be easier to acquire whenever Vesiphone's Vicious Vesper is active, with the elite Forsworn stunned.

An item collection, this was not a true set. There are no bonuses if you wear more than one or all of the items in this collection. When Naxxramas was upgraded for Wrath of the Lich King with the release of patch 3.0.2, the items in this set became unavailable. The Gilneas Liberation Front is the main Gilnean resistance group fighting against the Forsaken invasion of their nation. It was formed following the invasion of Gilneas at the time of the Cataclysm, and is made up of worgen and human soldiers who chose to remain behind after the evacuation of most of Gilneas's citizenry. Led by Lord Darius Crowley, the front's main objective is to defend Gilneas from the Forsaken and their Horde allies, and also to take back Lordaeron for the Alliance. In this effort, they have since enlisted the aid of several other like-minded groups, including the Hillsbrad humans, the 7th Legion, and the Bloodfang Pack.
